result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back in all six listings the task names plus the code lookup. The full suite passes (608 tests, `mvn -o test`), including a new test in `PromotionTest`.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`. Existing databases get it because the schema is created fresh on each `Database.openInMemory()`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: new last record component `description`, null when none was given.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new 6-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. A null or blank description is stored as null. The existing 5-argument method is kept and delegates with no description, so current callers (including the demo) are unchanged.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description. The six promotion reads (lookup by code, active on date, active in region, by category, best for category, unused in period) select it and map it into `Promotion`.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `keepsDescriptionInEveryListing` test. It checks the description on each listing and that a blank description comes back as null.

Nothing committed. I did not change `DemoScenario` or add descriptions to any sample data.
